title: SETTINGS KEEPS THE FOCUSED ROW IN VIEW AND HAS ONE FOCUS
why: Critic on Settings 27, 29 and 73 (2 each): the focused row is clipped at the top or sits in the bottom fade, no break between sections, the rail and the list both look focused with a different tab lit, a full-width lime restore button, and a long paragraph in the detail pane. Now a key step leaves the row clear of both edges, a line and a gap start each section, one focus at a time, the clicked tab stays lit, restore is a quiet box and the pane keeps the first clause of a hint.
now: Settings scrolls with the whole focused row in view, shows one focus at a time and has no lime box.

edits.anchor: function vis(x){ var a=sl.getBoundingClientRect(), c=x.getBoundingClientRect(), m=(c.top+c.bottom)/2, bar=sl.querySelector('.setjump'), t=a.top+(bar?bar.getBoundingClientRect().height:0); return !a.height||(m>=t&&m<=a.bottom); }
